subject: Scheduling: BrightLine / Redwood kickoff — pick a window + attendee clarity

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Were ready to lock in a 60-75 minute kickoff to align teams and surface any constraints before implementation. High-level goal: agree on milestones, owners, and immediate next steps for the first 30 days.

Possible windows (PT):
- Tue Nov 23: 10:00-11:15 or 15:00-16:15
- Wed Nov 24: 09:30-10:45
- Thu Nov 25: 11:00-12:15

2) Wed Nov 24, 09:30-10:45 PT
